settings.heading: What goes in, and what stays out.
settings.text: Our formulas pair sea plants with proven moisturizers and skip a long list of exclusions you can read below.

settings.title: Wakame
settings.text: A brown kelp that helps reinforce the moisture barrier.

settings.title: Red algae
settings.text: Smooths and softens, leaving skin feeling cushioned.

settings.title: Bladderwrack
settings.text: A firming brown seaweed that brings back radiance.

settings.title: Miru
settings.text: A fine green frond that hydrates while keeping oil in balance.

settings.heading: Every ingredient, in plain words.
settings.text: Look up the common and scientific name of each ingredient, and learn what role it plays in the formula.
settings.detail_text: A sea vegetable rich in minerals and sugars that bind water. It helps skin stay hydrated and smooth, especially in drier weather.

settings.name: Glycerin
settings.detail: A humectant that draws water into the skin

settings.name: Hyaluronic acid
settings.detail: Holds many times its weight in water

settings.name: Jojoba esters
settings.detail: A silky emollient that smooths and softens

settings.name: Lactic acid
settings.detail: A gentle exfoliant that lifts dull surface cells

settings.name: Squalane
settings.detail: A plant oil that cushions without clogging pores

settings.name: Undaria extract
settings.detail: The botanical name for wakame, used for barrier support

settings.label: Preservative and plasticizer concerns
settings.text: No parabens, phthalates or formaldehyde-releasing preservatives.

settings.label: Harsh cleansers and fillers
settings.text: No sulfates, silicones or mineral oil.

settings.label: Scent and color
settings.text: No synthetic fragrance or artificial dyes. Scented products use plant essences only.

settings.label: Animal-derived or tested
settings.text: Nothing from animals, and nothing tested on them.

settings.label: Trace contaminants
settings.text: No hydroquinone, coal tar or heavy metals added to any formula.

settings.image_alt: Dried seaweed laid out on stone
settings.heading: Cut by hand, never uprooted.
settings.text: Our harvesters trim only the top of each plant and leave the holdfast on the rock so the seaweed regrows within months. Watch how in the harvest film.

settings.heading: Join for early looks and offers
settings.message: Email and text sign-ups get a welcome discount, new launch alerts and the occasional routine guide.
